text:
jess_sales: Heads-up — large enterprise asking for a SOC 2 excerpt and a short acknowledgement (they called it a 'bridge') so they can kick off a POC. They want a limited evidence set available for 72h while NDA gets finalized. Can we stage redacted artifacts + presigned links? cc @omar_se @lina_legal

omar_se: We can stage. Need clarity on what to redact (IPs, userids, customer names?). Also what exact artifacts: SOC2 excerpt, sample infra config, latency logs? ETA to prepare once confirmed.

lina_legal: NDA is incoming — buyer said they'll sign within 24h. Legal prefers we provide a one-paragraph acknowledgement + presigned access to redacted artifacts rather than full report disclosure. We'll draft the ack once we see the artifacts. Ben, any security concerns?

ben_security: OK in principle. Requirements: redact IPs and any customer-identifying info, remove PII, keep KMS keys in our account (no key sharing). Presigned GETs should expire in 72h (259200s). We also need an access audit log (who accessed, when). No raw backups or secrets.

jess_sales: Great. Buyer needs access by tomorrow 9am PT. @omar_se can you create s3 path like s3://redwood-evidence/staging/vanguard-poc-1977/ and drop the files? I'll confirm timeline with customer.

omar_se: I'll prepare: soc2_excerpt_redacted.pdf, infra_snapshot.json (sanitized), and sample latency logs (last30days-redacted.log). Command I'm using for presign: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/staging/vanguard-poc-1977/soc2_excerpt_redacted.pdf --expires-in 259200``` I'll also add README.txt that explains redactions and the NDA link. ETA ~3 hours.

evidence-bot: evidence-bot: Upload detected — soc2_excerpt_redacted.pdf uploaded by omar_se at 1977771300. Presigned URLs created, expiry 72h. Access logging enabled.

lina_legal: Please include this sentence in README: "Provided under the terms of the signed NDA dated <insert date>. Materials are redacted to remove customer identifiers and PII." Legal will prepare the short acknowledgement letter (one paragraph) confirming we provided redacted SOC2 excerpt and temporary access window.

ben_security: Also: route access through internal proxy so we capture consistent principal names in logs. Add MD5 checksums in README for integrity verification. No object writes allowed via presigned PUTs.

maria_support: FYI I'll monitor the support queue in case buyer asks for different artifacts during the 72h. If they request deeper evidence we need a formal bridge request to Legal + CISO signoff.

jess_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll tell buyer: NDA incoming, presigned link + 72h window, README and one-paragraph acknowledgement to follow. If we don't get NDA signed in 24h we'll provide a timeboxed demo instead. :thumbsup:
